extraction_scope: Worker-6 source-reviewed mechanism/phenotype adjudication from primary XML, figures, and discussion.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: The paper tests whether the C-terminal Rana box is required by comparing natural nigrocin-HL with a deleted analog and a phenylalanine-amidated analog.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Design rationale, not direct mechanism of killing.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Nigrocin-HLM shows stronger source-tabulated MIC/MBC activity across tested bacteria/fungus and MRSA strains than nigrocin-HL/HLD.
mechanism_claims.limitations: MIC/MBC endpoints establish phenotype, not molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Nigrocin-HLM eradicates mature MRSA biofilm at the reported MBEC while nigrocin-HL does not reach activity in the tested range.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Biofilm viability assay does not identify a direct molecular target.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Nigrocin-HLM improves MRSA pneumonia model outcomes at 10 mg/kg compared with model control and is compared with vancomycin.
mechanism_claims.limitations: Therapeutic phenotype; mechanism is not directly assayed.

mechanism_claims.claim_text: Discussion-level membrane permeabilization/pore formation is speculative in this paper and is not promoted to direct mechanism evidence.
mechanism_claims.limitations: No direct permeabilization or molecular target assay is reported locally.
